data.professional_title: Senior Business Analyst – Liquidity | Treasury | LCR/NSFR | Regulatory
data.summary:
14 years of experience in IT, with extensive experience as a Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager across Banking, Risk, Treasury, Liquidity and Regulatory Reporting.
Strong experience in Liquidity Risk and Treasury, covering LCR, NSFR, Intraday Liquidity, liquidity forecasting, cash-flow analysis, liquidity monitoring and regulatory reporting within banking environments. ● Experienced in analysing intraday cash positions, cash inflows/outflows, funding requirements and liquidity positions, supporting liquidity monitoring, forecasting and reporting processes.
Hands-on experience in liquidity stress testing and scenario analysis, including assessment of liquidity positions, cash-flow impacts, funding requirements and potential shortfalls under different business scenarios.
Experienced in translating requirements from Treasury, Risk, Finance and IT into BRDs, FSDs, functional specifications, process flows, data-mapping documents, user stories and test scenarios.
Strong experience in source-to-target data mapping, data lineage, data validation, data reconciliation, data analysis and regulatory reporting, including supporting data/system migration and implementation initiatives.
Experienced in coordinating SIT/UAT, migration testing, defect management, stakeholder sign-offs, implementation, training and post-implementation support across banking and regulatory platforms.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience:
Nov 24 to August 26
Ajman Bank-(Dautam Consulting)
Credit Risk Business Analyst / Project Manager
Led end-to-end requirements across Credit Risk, ERM, Finance, Credit Administration and IT for IFRS 9 and Basel III initiatives.
Defined credit lifecycle requirements covering origination, approval, PD/LGD/EAD, limits, collateral, EWS and credit risk reporting.
Delivered BRD, FSD, user stories, RTM, process flows and data mapping aligned with IFRS 9 and Basel requirements.
Supported IFRS 9 implementation, including Stage 1/2/3 classification, SICR, 12-month/Lifetime ECL and PD/LGD/EAD validation.
Supported Basel III credit-risk implementation, including exposure classification, CRM, EAD, risk- weighting and RWA calculation requirements.
Played a key functional role in Moody’s CreditLens onboarding and integration, including source-to- target mapping, risk-rule configuration and output validation.
Coordinated SIT/UAT, data reconciliation, defect resolution and integration across business, IT and vendor teams.
Validated PD, LGD, EAD, ECL and credit-risk reporting outputs at account and portfolio levels.
Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank(Maveric systems)
Risk & Treasury Business Analyst July 2024 – October 2024
Led business analysis and functional implementation activities for Liquidity Risk and Treasury solutions
covering LCR and NSFR under Basel III.
Gathered and translated requirements from Treasury, Risk, Finance and IT into BRDs, functional specifications, process flows, data-mapping documents and test scenarios.
Supported intraday liquidity management and monitoring, analysing cash positions, cash inflows/outflows, funding requirements and liquidity movements across relevant banking data sources.
Supported liquidity forecasting and cash-flow projections, analysing expected inflows, outflows, funding requirements and liquidity positions to support Treasury decision-making and reporting. ● Performed liquidity stress testing and scenario analysis, assessing the impact of different cash-flow, funding and liquidity scenarios on overall liquidity positions and identifying potential shortfalls.
Supported LCR regulatory reporting, including HQLA classification, cash-flow categorisation, inflows/outflows, run-off assumptions and LCR calculation logic.
Performed source-to-target data mapping and validation for deposits, funding, securities, cash positions and contractual cash-flow data supporting downstream liquidity calculations and reporting.
Analysed and reconciled liquidity data across source systems, transformed datasets, liquidity calculations and regulatory reporting outputs, investigating discrepancies and supporting data-quality remediation.
Supported NSFR implementation and reporting, including Available Stable Funding (ASF), Required Stable Funding (RSF), funding classifications and maturity calculations.
Supported liquidity data/system migration and integration activities, validating source-to-target mappings, migrated data, calculations and downstream reporting outputs.
Coordinated migration testing, SIT and UAT, including test-case preparation, defect tracking, business validation and stakeholder sign-offs.
Worked closely with Treasury, Risk, Finance, IT and vendor teams throughout requirements, data validation, testing and implementation activities.
Maveric Systems – Product Manager | Wolters Kluwer – Credit Risk / Regulatory Reporting March 2024 – January 2025
Worked on Wolters Kluwer OneSumX Regulatory Reporting solutions, supporting COREP regulatory reporting requirements for banking clients.
Gathered and analyzed requirements from Risk, Finance, Regulatory Reporting, IT and client SMEs, translating regulatory requirements into functional specifications.
Supported COREP report implementation and enhancement, including regulatory rules, data requirements, validations and reporting logic.
Worked on source-to-target data mapping from banking/risk systems into OneSumX regulatory reporting structures.
Analyzed data lineage and dependencies across source systems, OneSumX Data Foundation and Regulatory Engine, supporting accurate COREP reporting.
Supported configuration and validation of COREP templates, data elements, business rules and regulatory validations.
Conducted functional testing, SIT and UAT, including test scenarios, test execution, defect analysis and resolution with development and QA teams.
Performed data reconciliation and report validation between source data, OneSumX calculations and generated COREP outputs.
Coordinated with Wolters Kluwer product teams, client stakeholders, SMEs and development teams to resolve functional issues and deliver regulatory-reporting enhancements.
Prepared BRD/FSD, mapping documents, process flows, test plans and implementation documentation
supporting COREP releases.
Supported client implementation, production issues, regulatory-reporting enhancements and user training for OneSumX COREP reporting.
Wipro Limited-March 22 to July 23-Senior consultant /Business Analyst:
Responsible for documenting and getting user concurrence on Functional Requirements Specification, Operations Process Design of Business user requirements through conducting requirements elicitation, analysis, discussions, and sign offs
Worked on PRA110 rules and RWA calculation for Cynergy risk transformation program. ● Production of Quarterly/monthly Basel III credit risk capital adequacy calculations ● Production of ECL reports for IFRS9/INDAS Monthly/Quarterly ● Capital impact analysis ● Understanding of data/methodology issues ● Worked on Basel standardized batches for RCA 3 report generation. ● Participation in ongoing compliance of regulation ● Ad hoc analysis and regulatory data requests ● UAT Assistance ● Worked on OFSAA Tool for Credit risk modelling and reporting. ● Participation in project work and assistance with project management for major deliverables ● Become comfortable with analyzing and reconciling large amounts of risk data ● Regular contact with external Clients and Financial Institutions to respond to queries, obtain and provide information.
HDFC Basel /IFRS Project-Sep21 to March-22
Project Manager
Communicate, and Track Project lifecycle activities from concept, product delivery, UAT ● Implementation activities to meet business deadlines and comply with IT governance policies and processes. ● objective is to create visibility of BSG projects to project stakeholders and complete activities within mutually agreeable timelines through handoffs, signoffs, updates, and follow-up
Responsible for documenting and getting user concurrence on Functional Requirements Specification, Operations Process Design of Business user requirements through conducting requirements elicitation, analysis, discussions, and sign offs
Ensure that Requirements are captured “First Time Right” from the user and documented into cost effective, efficient TO-BE processes by reducing process redundancies and deficiencies.

Observe, Interact with Users, System owners and Document AS-IS business processes in a domain and identify process improvements and pain areas. Discussion on Pain Areas with Process Owner
Follow up with Process Manager and BSG Team for implementation of Pain Areas, Implementation of each Pain Areas in the process identified, Update progress of each Pain Area for solution /enhancement implemented, ensure proper flow of Process post implementation, Document any change / up-gradation of process
Agile BA /IFRS 9/Cecl-Credit Risk Modeling UBS INDIA from June 2018 till 2021-June ● Collaborated with all stakeholders in every project. ● Completed quality assurance testing of developed applications and identified code areas that needed
improvements.
Wrote user requirements specification (URS) and Functional requirements specification (FRS) documents as per the business requirements and process flow.
Work with the quantitative research group to improve risk calculations ● Apply project management practices across all phases of software development life cycle (SDLC) ● Develop and manage detailed project plans and project updates for stakeholders ● Opportunities to manage key strategic projects or components of work ● Work with development team to analyze and resolve defects ● Perform System Functional testing ● Streamlined projects to make them meet changing needs. ● Was highly responsive to the team and clients. ● Utilizing Tosca Automation Tool for atomising the Application testing. ● Attending scrum calls and Meetings ● Attending Agile ceremonies. ● Following Sprints deliverables. ● Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL) is a new credit loss accounting standard (model) that was issued by the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) on June 16, 2016. The CECL standard focuses on estimation of expected losses over the life of the loans, while the current standard relies on incurred losses. Interviewed business users to gather requirements and analyzed the feasibility of their needs by coordinating with the project manager and technical lead
Identified, researched, investigated, analyzed, defined opportunities for business process improvement, documented business processes and initiated efforts to make improvements.
Contributed to the definition of scope, performed extensive requirement analysis and defined functional specifications
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and used Requisite Pro to manage, analyze, and convert business requirements into functional specifications
